title: matra error, schema 2.x
description: One failure as matra reports it: the serde form of `matra::domain::Error` (`kind`, `message`, `details`), and of `matra::domain::DocumentError`, which adds `path`. Python's `analyze_path` returns the second for a document that failed, and every Python exception matra raises carries the first as `kind`, `str(exc)` and `details`. Read by the same rules as the document schema: ignore fields you do not recognize, treat every string set as open (`kind` and `io_kind` among them), and reject a major you do not know. Branch on `kind`, read values from `details`, and never parse `message`, which is for a person and may change. A detail that does not apply is absent; a key a kind carries keeps appearing in later versions.

kind.description: The stable name of the failure: `model_not_found`, `model_invalid`, `parse_failed`, `input_too_large`, `unsupported_format`, `invalid_input` or `io`. An open set.

message.description: The error's text, for a person. Every dynamic value in it is also in `details`.

details.description: Every dynamic value in `message`, by name. The keys depend on `kind`; each value is a string, a whole number or a boolean.

path.description: On a per-document failure only: the file the document came from, or null for input that never came from disk.
The path where no model was found.

reason.description: What went wrong, as the variant's own text.

what.description: The gate that fired: `input`, `file_source`, `tfidf`, `textrank`, `rake`, `yake`, `clusters`, `udpipe_download`, `embedding_download` or `config_file`. An open set.

actual.description: The size measured against the cap.

format.description: The format recognised (`pdf`, `docx`), absent when the bytes are neither UTF-8 text nor a signature matra recognises.

feature.description: The Cargo feature that would read `format`, absent when none does.

io_kind.description: The class of the I/O failure, in snake case: `not_found`, `permission_denied`, `already_exists`, `unsupported`, `invalid_input`, `invalid_data`, `timed_out`, `not_connected`, `connection_refused`, `connection_reset`, `unexpected_eof`, `interrupted`, `not_a_directory`, `is_a_directory`, `storage_full` or `other`. An open set.

path.description: The path the failure concerns, when matra named one.

url.description: The URL of a download that did not arrive.

retryable.description: On a download that did not arrive: whether the same call can be made again as it is and may succeed. Absent elsewhere, which makes no claim either way.
